name: Perspective Gallery
description: Full-height image slider where the active card sits centered and neighbouring cards tilt and shrink to the sides, with serial, title and description revealed on the active card.
contents: Stack of image cards with serial label, title, description and a view link
behavior: Active card is centered at full scale, neighbours fade, scale down, shift and rotate slightly
Arrow buttons step through slides, optionally looping
Card text fades in only on the active card
editableByProps: Slides, images, titles, serials and descriptions
Background color, card size, transition speed, tilt spacing and scale

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tilt angles of side cards

needsCodeEdit.where: text-white/40 classes on the Back and Forward buttons

fixed: Root is a full viewport height section with hidden overflow
Card text colors are white over a dark gradient
View link is a decorative button without a link target
